units.source_text: 想腻了，等烦了，结果我成了难以摆脱欲求的俘虏，只想哪怕一次，也要明确地捕捉老师的憎恶的面孔。

en.t: Tired of thinking and sick of waiting, I ended up a prisoner of a desire I could not escape, wanting only to catch, if just once, a clear glimpse of the teacher's hateful face.

units.source_text: 最后，我想出了这样的诡计：

en.t: In the end, I came up with the following trick:

units.source_text: 我狂妄，也充满稚气，明知首先会给我带来不利，

en.t: I was arrogant and full of childishness, and although I knew it would first of all work against me,

units.source_text: 我却已经不能克制自己，甚至不顾这种恶作剧会导致老师对我更大的误解。

en.t: I could no longer restrain myself, and I did not even care that this prank would lead the teacher to misunderstand me even more deeply.
